## Current role

**Software Engineer, SafariDesk** — March 2025 to present. SafariDesk is a help
desk and ticketing SaaS: shared inbox, SLA controls, email-to-ticket intake,
knowledge base, customer portal, cloud and self-hosted Docker deployments.

Work spans a Django and PostgreSQL backend and a React and TypeScript frontend.
Contributions include per-tenant branded transactional email, a unified real-time
event broadcast layer, OAuth token refresh for Google and Microsoft mailboxes,
multi-tenant data isolation fixes, the knowledge base and public help centre, and
a shared form component library.

Also builds Safe Redact, a C# WPF desktop application on .NET 10 that detects and
removes personal information from documents, images, audio and video using local
ONNX models with DirectML GPU acceleration.

## Previous

**Kenya Power (KPLC), ICT & Telecommunication Division, Nakuru** — industrial
attachment, January to July 2024. Frontline ICT support: Windows user support,
service desk monitoring and resolution-time reporting, LAN/WAN and Cisco
equipment, VHF/HF radio systems, equipment inventory. Built an internal device
check-in and check-out system.

## Education

Evaluation Company, a NACES member, in June 2026.

Note for accuracy: the credential held is a Kenyan Diploma. The Associate of
Science is a US equivalency determination by an external evaluator, not a degree
awarded to him.

## Selected projects

- **SafariDesk** — help desk and ticketing SaaS. Django, React, TypeScript,
  PostgreSQL, Docker. https://safaridesk.io
- **Safe Redact** — Windows desktop application removing personal data from
  documents, images, audio and video. C#, .NET 10, WPF, ONNX Runtime, DirectML.
- **Ellie** — local-first meeting notetaker for Windows and Android. C#, Windows

  and Google Play bundles.
- **Boval** — multi-tenant booking platform. FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Next.js,
  Docker.
- **SOVAS** — multi-portal learning management system. Django, React, Docker.
- **Vision** — proactive AI voice assistant. FastAPI, LiveKit, pgvector, Flutter.
